Coram : A.M. KHANWILKAR, BHUSHAN RAMKRISHNA GAVAI, HRISHIKESH ROY
Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process – Information Memorandum – Prepared by Resolution Professional – Appellant- creditor’s name was put in the ‘List of Other Creditors’ and was not reflected in ‘Claims – Appellant’s claim that its name should have been reflected in ‘Claims of Operational Creditors’ – Held: Since the claim of the appellant is still pending adjudication before the Arbitrator, it has rightly been described in the memorandum as other creditors
Decision Date : 16-11-2020 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 2798/2020 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 3 Judges
